verdict: OBSTRUCTION: device closed at stage A; T-NR (c > 2) and a scattering-level Blaschke control pass every analytic step of the Maass-Selberg inequality; strip arguments occur only as numerator zeros
claim: Nothing about zeros of zeta. Loop-group Borel Eisenstein series of SL_2: coefficients are chain products of M(u)=xi(u)/xi(u+1) at u=z+kc, kc-z. In the chamber 0<Re z<Re c all denominators (constant term, degenerate Whittaker terms) have Re>1; strip arguments occur only in numerators (relative to Garland, FKP; not opened). Rank-one Maass-Selberg positivity is equivalent to N=z(1-S)/(1+S), S=T^(-z)M, being Nevanlinna in z^2 (proved), and is preserved under Blaschke factors over non-real conjugate pairs (proved): zeros can be inserted anywhere in Re z>0. T-NR c>2 and control BLS pass; DH passes formally below height 2000; formal E_a fails (measured). At c=1 every non-identity coefficient is xi(z)/xi(z+n). Affine two-variable kernel: closure argued, not proved. Author referee pass only.
refereeNote: author adversarial pass with a separate script, not independent; three corrections applied
